senses.sense_definition: iemand die beroepsmatig of vrijwillig hulp biedt aan mensen in nood

examples.text: De <w>hulpverlener</w> bood direct steun aan de slachtoffers van het ongeluk.

target_lang_translations.en: The <w>aid worker</w> offered immediate support to the victims of the accident.

examples.text: Na de aardbeving probeerde elke <w>hulpverlener</w> ter plaatse zo snel mogelijk medische zorg te verlenen.

target_lang_translations.en: After the earthquake, every <w>relief worker</w> on site tried to provide medical care as quickly as possible.

target_lang_definitions.en: someone who provides professional or voluntary assistance to people in need

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: someone working for a charitable or international organization
someone providing professional care or social services
someone providing assistance in disaster or conflict zones

senses.sense_definition: iemand die als eerste ter plaatse is om noodhulp te verlenen bij een incident

examples.text: Als <w>hulpverlener</w> moet je in stressvolle situaties kalm kunnen blijven.

target_lang_translations.en: As a <w>first responder</w>, you must be able to stay calm in stressful situations.

examples.text: De eerste <w>hulpverlener</w> ter plaatse begon direct met de reanimatie van het slachtoffer.

target_lang_translations.en: The first <w>emergency worker</w> on the scene immediately began resuscitating the victim.

target_lang_definitions.en: someone who is first on the scene to provide emergency assistance during an incident

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: emergency services personnel arriving first at a scene
